idea-plugin.name: Vyra Theme
idea-plugin.description:
Vyra Theme is a dark theme for JetBrains IDEs based on the Impoo color scheme.

  • Editor color scheme inspired by GitHub Dark, with semantic highlighting for classes, methods, fields, parameters and annotations.
  • Consistent UI on #161B22: panels, trees, lists, tables, menus, popups, toolbars, status bar, tool window tabs and editor tabs.
  • Icons recolored to match the same palette.

Enable it from Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Appearance | Theme | Vyra Theme.
